ideas.pitch: A real-time collaborative coding evaluation platform tailored for academic hackathons and online technical challenges.
ideas.title: TeachPulse Interactive Coding Assessment Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since the hackathon is organized by an engineering college and called Teach Pulse, an educational coding evaluation tool directly mirrors the organizers' core context, appealing heavily to academic judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent mentor and Q&A system that assists students with debugging and coding challenge guidelines.
ideas.title: PulseRAG Student Support Multi-Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven multi-agent RAG architecture that won similar student hackathons by providing tangible utility to participants during the event.

ideas.pitch: An automated booking platform that matches students with available faculty mentors based on specific technical queries.
ideas.title: EduFlow Automated Appointment and Mentorship Scheduler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a concrete logistical problem for educational institutions with an intuitive workflow and automated communication integrations.

ideas.pitch: A predictive analytics dashboard that monitors student submission error rates and forecasts debugging bottlenecks using regression models.
ideas.title: CodeTelemetry Incident Forecasting and Analytics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings rigorous statistical modeling and predictive evaluation metrics directly to an academic coding challenge context.

ideas.pitch: A secure submission verification and anti-plagiarism system designed specifically for online student coding competitions.
ideas.title: SecurePulse Identity and Submission Verifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a vital administrative pain point for online hackathons with robust technical verification checks.
